import urllib.request, json, time, threading

base = "http://127.0.0.1:8090"
def post(path, payload):
    req = urllib.request.Request(base + path, data=json.dumps(payload).encode(), headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"}, method="POST")
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10) as r:
        return json.loads(r.read().decode())

def get(path):
    with urllib.request.urlopen(base + path, timeout=10) as r:
        return json.loads(r.read().decode())

# 1. Verify HTML & JS/CSS assets include Global Running Banner, Stop Button & Delete Button
html = urllib.request.urlopen(base + "/").read().decode()
assert "global-running-progress-banner" in html, "missing global-running-progress-banner in index.html"
assert "ctx-btn-stop-task" in html, "missing ctx-btn-stop-task in index.html"
assert "ctx-btn-delete-task" in html, "missing ctx-btn-delete-task in index.html"
assert "btn-cleanup-done-tasks" in html, "missing btn-cleanup-done-tasks in index.html"

# 2. Create temporary task TASK-LIVE-VERIFY
d1 = post("/api/tasks", {"external_id": "TASK-LIVE-VERIFY", "title": "Live Runtime Verify Stop & Delete", "description": "Verify on :8090", "priority": 1})
assert d1["active_task_key"] == "TASK-LIVE-VERIFY"
assert d1["live_execution"]["is_running"] is False, f"Idle task must have is_running=False, got {d1[\"live_execution\"]}"

# 3. Trigger plan with step_delay_ms=1200 in background thread, observe active running state, then stop it
err_holder = []
def run_bg():
    try:
        post("/api/tasks/action", {"task_key": "TASK-LIVE-VERIFY", "action": "plan", "step_delay_ms": 1200})
    except Exception as e:
        err_holder.append(str(e))

t = threading.Thread(target=run_bg)
t.start()
observed = False
for _ in range(25):
    time.sleep(0.08)
    dp = get("/api/dashboard?task_key=TASK-LIVE-VERIFY")
    if dp.get("live_step_progress", {}).get("active") and dp["live_step_progress"].get("task_key") == "TASK-LIVE-VERIFY":
        observed = True
        assert dp["live_step_progress"]["can_stop"] is True
        assert dp["live_execution"]["is_running"] is True
        break
assert observed, "Expected to observe live_step_progress.active=True on :8090"

# 4. Stop the running task via POST /api/tasks/stop
d_stop = post("/api/tasks/stop", {"task_key": "TASK-LIVE-VERIFY", "reason": "Live runtime check on :8090"})
t.join(timeout=3)
assert d_stop["active_task_stage"] == "NEEDS_YOU", f"Expected NEEDS_YOU after stop, got {d_stop[\"active_task_stage\"]}"
assert d_stop["live_execution"]["was_stopped"] is True, f"Expected was_stopped=True, got {d_stop[\"live_execution\"]}"

# 5. Delete TASK-LIVE-VERIFY via POST /api/tasks/delete
d_del = post("/api/tasks/delete", {"mode": "single", "task_key": "TASK-LIVE-VERIFY"})
keys_after = [x["external_id"] for x in d_del.get("queued_tasks", [])]
assert "TASK-LIVE-VERIFY" not in keys_after, "TASK-LIVE-VERIFY must be removed after delete"
print("LIVE :8090 VERIFICATION PASSED: Banner + Idle-Fix + Live-Running-Telemetry + Stop-Control + Delete-Task all verified!")
